evidence.printed_label: HDC - system kontroli zjazdu ze wzniesienia (wyłącznie dla wersji Extreme oraz 4x4)
evidence.existing_status_interpretation: The six existing configuration-level values implement the strict conjunction interpretation: Extreme grade AND 4x4 drivetrain.

finding.issue: The grade-level matrix marks Expression, Extreme and Journey as standard, while the accompanying qualifier limits HDC to 'Extreme oraz 4x4'. The wording does not establish whether Extreme and 4x4 are conjunctive conditions or two independent applicability groups. The grade matrix is not powertrain-specific and cannot resolve this conflict for the six exact configurations.
candidate_interpretations: Strict conjunction: Extreme grade AND 4x4 drivetrain; this matches the existing single standard value for Extreme tribrid 150 4x4.
Disjunction: Extreme grade OR 4x4 drivetrain; this would produce a different configuration truth table.
Grade-matrix reading: Expression, Extreme and Journey standard across the displayed grade columns; this conflicts with the restrictive qualifier and is not safe to project to exact configurations.
finding.disposition: Do sprawdzenia; retain all six existing configuration-level values without modification. No Boolean operator or powertrain applicability is inferred.

verification.existing_test_contract: Confirms the source qualifier, grade-level matrix, six existing configuration statuses, explicit Do sprawdzenia disposition, and zero master-data/status changes.
verification.source_integrity_contract: Verifies the archived PDF SHA-256 and all 564 source-linked equipment observations.

report_metadata.scope: Bigster MY26 Polish cennik effective 2026-10-01, printed page 4; HDC applicability across the six exact source-linked configurations and comparison with the grade-level equipment matrix.

findings.detail: The qualifier 'Extreme oraz 4x4' and the grade-level matrix do not establish a unique configuration-level truth table; retain all six existing statuses and mark the fact Do sprawdzenia.
